FOOTNOTES

1/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as a Lump Sum by Agency.

The Baseline includes \$2,766,900 and 27 FTE Positions from the Board of Behavioral Health Examiners Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. Adjustments are as follows:

Remove One-Time Office Space Reorganization The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(187,900) from the Board of Behavioral Health Examiners Fund in FY 2027 to remove one-time office space reorganization costs due to the addition of 7 FTE Positions in the FY 2025 budget.

Remove One-Time E-Licensing Transition Funding The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(20,400) from the Board of Behavioral Health Examiners Fund in FY 2027 to remove one-time costs associated with an e-licensing transition consultant.
